newsitem.title: USA: Pentair Q4 results boosted by high demand.
newsitem.headline: Pentair Q4 results boosted by high demand.

text.p: Pentair Inc said Thursday high demand for new professional tools and automotive service equipment helped boost the company's fourth quarter earnings to record levels.
Strong results in the company's enclosure and water products businesses also gave the fourth quarter a boost.
Earlier, Pentair reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.55 a share versus $0.44 on sales of $426.90 million versus $377.49 million.

"These results demonstrate our ability to build our industrial companies through new product development and manufacturing efficiencies, while successfully acquiring complementary businesses around the world," Winslow Buxton, chairman and chief executive of Pentair, said in a statement.
Pentair said sales outside of North America in 1996 accounted for 20 percent of net sales -- up from six percent in 1993.
Pentair is a diversified manufacturer of electronic enclosures, professional tools and water products. Shares of Pentair were up 1/8 at 30-5/8.
